items.title: 1.10 Oxides aur chlorides mein oxidation number ki tabdeeli (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.10, printed page 18.

blocks.title: Oxidation number
blocks.text: Atom ka oxidation number, ya oxidation state, molecule ya ion mein us atom par rasmi (formal) charge hai. Ionic compounds mein yeh woh charge hai jo ion par zahir hota hai.

Period 3 ke unsur ke liye us ke oxide ya chloride mein oxidation number bonding ke liye istemal hone wale electrons ki tadaad ke mutabiq hai aur hamesha musbat hai, kyunke oxygen aur chlorine in anasir mein se kisi se bhi zyada electronegative hain. Yeh group number se milta hai, jo kul valence electrons ki akkasi karta hai. Oxides mein oxidation number sodium ke +1 se sulfur ke +6 tak barhta hai; chlorides mein sodium ke +1 se phosphorus ke +5 tak. Phosphorus aur sulfur kai oxidation numbers dikhate hain kyunke yeh electrons ko khali 3d orbitals mein ubhar (excite) kar apna octet phaila sakte hain: SO2 mein sulfur +4 hai kyunke bonding ke liye sirf chaar electrons istemal hote hain, jab ke SO3 mein +6 kyunke sab chhe istemal hote hain.

blocks.prompt: SO2 aur SO3 mein sulfur ka oxidation number nikalein, aur samjhayein ke kuch p block anasir mukhtalif oxidation states kyun dikhate hain.
blocks.explanation: Har oxygen -2 hai. SO2 mein x + 2(-2) = 0 se x = +4; SO3 mein x + 3(-2) = 0 se x = +6. Phosphorus aur sulfur electrons ko apne khali 3d orbitals mein ubhar kar bonding ke liye zyada valence electrons istemal kar sakte hain, jo phosphorus ke liye +3 ya +5 aur sulfur ke liye +4 ya +6 deta hai.

items: Oxidation number molecule ya ion mein atom par rasmi charge hai; period 3 ke oxides aur chlorides mein yeh musbat hai aur bonding mein istemal electrons ke barabar, group number se milta hua: oxides mein +1 (Na) se +6 (S), chlorides mein +1 se +5 (P).
P aur S 3d orbitals mein octet phaila kar kai qeematein dikhate hain: SO2 +4, SO3 +6.
